author: ContinueRQLS10b

qualification_v4.note: supervisor-side items only here; the package successor is separate

items: P1 post_publish_mono summary after all publications and directory fsyncs
P2 lane roots real directory chains

simplifications: no helper processes: the /bin/date helper and all helper code are removed; timestamps are Python wall-clock renderings of recorded epoch values (labelled), raw monotonic and epoch values kept
no birth-ancestry inference: p_puniqueid is no longer read; every unproved new same-uid identity blocks settlement
fault injection reduced to identity_check_fails (date_helper_fails no longer exists)

v7_review_new_findings.title: exec after reparenting defeats the lineage classifier
v7_review_new_findings.v8: Sup.classify uses only CURRENT parents (ppid) of identified processes: a NEW (uniqueid > U0) same-uid process is UNRELATED only if its chain of identified, untraced NEW ancestors with ppid > 1 ends at an identified OLD process other than launchd; it is OWNED if the chain reaches the child; otherwise UNPROVED (blocking). A reparented escapee has ppid 1 and is UNPROVED whatever it execs. Relies on the kernel rule that orphans go to initproc and traced processes back to their original parent (xnu kern_exit.c lines 2425-2476 of the lane copy) and on PROC_FLAG_TRACED; same-uid means effective OR real uid equals the supervisor's.
v7_review_new_findings.residual: launchd-started NEW same-uid processes block while alive (fail-closed); a descendant that drops both effective and real uid is outside the census (reviewed child caps)

v7_review_new_findings.title: disappearance before identification loses coverage
v7_review_new_findings.v8: a listed pid that disappears or changes before identification, or before/after any cwd/argv/task/start measurement (each bracketed by uniqueid re-reads), makes the census INCOMPLETE; a clear observation requires a complete census (bounded retries); the final census must be complete (FINAL_CENSUS_INCOMPLETE otherwise)

v7_review_new_findings.title: late clear bypasses grace expiry
v7_review_new_findings.v8: observe() accepts a clear observation only if the census that established it completed (mono_done) before every applicable cutoff; otherwise GRACE_EXPIRED_* is latched; sleeps are clamped to the remaining grace; the clear time is retained in the receipt

v7_review_new_findings.title: helper identity and exceptional ownership
v7_review_new_findings.v8: no helper process exists any more; the child is registered (Popen kept, pid recorded) as the first statements of the protected post-spawn block and again in the exception handler if needed

v7_review_new_findings.title: bounded I/O accepts elapsed-budget overruns
v7_review_new_findings.v8: Deadline objects shared per operation group, checked before and after every operation including the final write, fsync, close and re-read (no fresh re-read budget); census checks its deadline every 64 pids and at the end; root inventories iterate scandir with an enforced entry limit; lane walk through descriptors with entry, depth and time limits
v7_review_new_findings.residual: native calls cannot be interrupted; overruns are detected on return and fail closed

v7_review_new_findings.title: GO can be expired, out of budget or over limits
v7_review_new_findings.v8: both admission censuses are enforced; GO revalidation immediately before GO: complete census with only the child blocking and lane_busy + cpu_slots <= 2 and RSS headroom, stability age, GO expiry, free space, spawn age <= min(60 s, max_wall_s / 2), no stop, no latched failure, no cancel; cancel is read once more immediately before the single GO write (linearization point); cancel checks also between samples creation and spawn and after thread setup

v7_review_new_findings.title: final resource accounting incomplete
v7_review_new_findings.v8: finalization applies RSS/BUSY to the final census, recomputes aggregate output bytes and late stream overflow (OUTPUT, STREAM_CAP), re-walks the lane (LANE_CEILING), then serializes receipt and settlement record and requires the exact projected bytes to fit the free floor, the lane ceiling and the remaining reservation (PUBLICATION_BUDGET)

v7_review_new_findings.title: wrong filesystem, partly anchored traversal
v7_review_new_findings.v8: admission requires lane, lane_disk_root, TMPDIR and every output root on one st_dev; free space by fstatvfs on the output root descriptor; walk_bytes traverses through O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW descriptors, verifies each opened directory's (dev, ino) and refuses mount boundaries

v7_review_new_findings.title: inventory not exact per root; creation identity unproved
v7_review_new_findings.v8: per-root allowlists (Sup.allow); supervisor-created files (sinks, samples, launch record, receipt, settlement record) keep their (dev, ino) from creation and must still be those inodes (EVIDENCE_REPLACED); settlement NAME and NAME.staged must be the same inode with two links; child outputs must be regular, one link, birth time >= spawn epoch (no slack)
v7_review_new_findings.residual: exclusive creation of child outputs is the reviewed child's contract

v7_review_new_findings.title: successful acknowledgment after incomplete publication
v7_review_new_findings.v8: directory fsync of EVERY output root after both publications; any publication, re-read or directory-fsync failure gives exit 12/13 with acknowledged=false; post_publish_mono is read only after all of that and printed in the single summary with both verified digests; any supervisor cancel not handled during the run suppresses success (exit 14, acknowledged=false); parent commit remains the only authority and release

v5_findings_remaining_partial_in_v7.v8: helper paths removed; publication failures give unsuccessful acknowledgment
helpers removed; single reaper for the child unchanged
see new findings 7 and 8; parent serialization remains the reservation authority
limits applied to every census: admission (both), pre-GO, running, final

qualification_review_items_supported_her: cpu_slots config key (1..2), bound in the GO entry; admission and GO checks use lane_busy + cpu_slots <= 2, independent of the busy_limit trip threshold (busy2 control reserves both slots)

census records lane_busy_pids and blocking_detail [pid, comm, class, ppid, zombie] in every sample for identity proofs; BUSY trip detail carries the busy pids; STREAM_CAP detail carries the stream counters

interface_for_the_parent.stdout_summary: exactly one JSON line: acknowledged, exit_code, settlement, receipt, receipt_sha256, settlement_record, settlement_record_sha256, post_publish_mono, child_returncode, trips, failures[:10], supervisor, config_sha256 (unsuccessful forms carry acknowledged=false and a reason)

exit_codes.13: settlement publication or directory sync failed
